summary.headline: Google conversions stopped recording on 7 Oct while spend continued — fix tracking before any budget moves. Separately, about 1.7–2.8 lakh INR/month is going to a zero-conversion competitor campaign and non-converting search terms.

findings.title: Meta 'Results'-style reporting not reconciled with backend orders
findings.description: Meta ROAS (1.32) is platform-attributed. Without order/CRM data for the same window we cannot tell how much is incremental or double-counted with Google.
findings.recommendation: Export orders for 11 Sep–10 Oct and run a reconciliation before changing Meta budgets.

experiments.hypothesis: Cutting 'Competitor - Broad' and moving its budget to 'DSA - Catalog' lowers blended Google CPA without losing conversions
experiments.design: Pre/post with a 2-week holdout window after tracking is fixed; alternatively a campaign-level Google Ads experiment on DSA budget
experiments.decision_rule: Keep if CPA falls ≥10% with conversions within −5%

reasons: pre/post is weaker than a split test

questions: Was any tag, consent banner or site release deployed around 6–7 Oct 2026?
Is the Video Views campaign judged on reach/views rather than purchases?
assumptions: Conversion values are in INR and include tax
